I bought RightFont before. Is my license still valid?

Yes. Your license keeps working with the versions it covers. Open the License Manager with your purchase email to see whether it works with RightFont 2026.1.1, upgrade it if it doesn’t, and free the seats of Macs you no longer use.

## Didn’t find your answer?

Write to us at support@rightfontapp.com. Someone on the RightFont team reads and answers every message. [...] Does RightFont need an account or an internet connection?

You don’t need an account. RightFont checks your license online each time it starts, so it needs an internet connection then. Once it’s running, it keeps working if the connection drops. If it starts without a connection, the fonts it activated stay off until it can check: it tries again every few minutes and switches them back on as soon as the check succeeds. Your fonts stay in your own folders.

Can I preview fonts without installing them?

Yes. Every font in your library previews immediately, with your own text, size and style — whether or not it is active. Activate a font only when you want to use it in another app.

How does automatic activation of missing fonts work? [...] How does automatic activation of missing fonts work?

When you open a document in a supported app, RightFont checks the fonts it uses and activates the ones that are missing. Fonts it cannot find are listed, with a note when your library has a different version.

Which versions of the Adobe apps does RightFont work with?

Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign from 2022, and InCopy, After Effects and Premiere Pro from 2019, up to their 2027 releases. Turn an app on in Settings › Plugins, and RightFont installs its plugin.
